description: The main window loads remote Guidon content and is treated as untrusted per the desktop app's design spec (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-15-desktop-app-design.md): it is granted ZERO Tauri API access. The same applies to the small Tasks window (label 'tasks', see windows.rs), which loads the web app's /mini page. Do not add permissions here for the main window; native features are implemented in local, bundled windows only (e.g. the Settings window, see capabilities/settings.json).
